description: This file provides help and documentation functions for the 'gn' build system, including printing help topics, command descriptions, and handling user requests for help on specific topics or commands.

methods.name: PrintToplevelHelp
methods.description: Prints the top-level help sections including commands, target declarations, functions, variables, and other topics.

methods.name: PrintSwitchHelp
methods.description: Prints help information about available command-line switches.

methods.name: PrintAllHelp
methods.description: Prints comprehensive help documentation including all commands and topics, formatted in markdown if specified.

methods.name: PrintHelpOnSwitch
methods.description: Prints help information for a specific command-line switch.

methods.name: PrintArgsHelp
methods.description: Prints help information about the ambiguous 'args' command and variable.

methods.name: RunHelp
methods.description: Main function to process 'gn help' commands and display appropriate help topics based on user input.
